citation.ref: Epoch AI, Data on AI Models

provenance: Training time (hours) field of Epoch AI's all_ai_models.csv, downloaded 2026-09-25 (sha256 in PROVENANCE.md), divided by 24 and rounded to 0.1 day. One point per model: x is the release date as a fractional year (Epoch's Publication date), y is days. The 13 models were chosen by the author for recognizability from every large language model Epoch gives a training time. basis: 'reported' = the developer states the duration; 'derived' = Epoch computes it from the developer's own figures (chip-hours over chip count); 'estimate' = Epoch's own estimate or a third-party figure Epoch records (SemiAnalysis for GPT-4, Emad Mostaque for Mistral Large, correspondence with the lab for GLM-4.6). No value comes from outside Epoch's database.

models.name: PaLM
models.epochNote: 6144 TPUv4 for 1200 hours + 3072 TPUv4 for 336 hours. Equivalent to 6144 TPUv4 for 1368 hours.

models.name: GLM-130B
models.epochNote: "During the 60-day access to the cluster, we manage to train GLM-130B for 400 billion tokens" 60 days * 24 = 1,440 hours

models.name: LLaMA-65B
models.epochNote: "When training a 65B-parameter model, our code processes around 380 tokens/sec/GPU on 2048 A100 GPU with 80GB of RAM. This means that training over our dataset containing 1.4T tokens takes approximately 21 days."

models.name: GPT-4
models.epochNote: (Speculative) SemiAnalysis conjectures that GPT-4 training took 90-100 days with utilization of 32-36%.

models.name: Llama 2-70B
models.epochNote: Model was trained from January 2023 to July 2023, which is six months. However, the training run duration did not take up this whole period. According to a Meta employee interviewed by Epoch, Llama 2 34B and 70B were trained on different clusters, with overlapping training periods. Based on an estimate of 1000 GPUs, it would have taken 72 days.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.epochNote: Speculation by Emad Mostaque: 20M euro spent at Scaleway (1.9 euro per H100-hour) would be around 3 months on 4000 H100s.

models.name: Phi-3.5-MoE
models.epochNote: GPUs: 512 H100-80G Training time: 23 days 23 days * 24 hours / day = 552 hours

models.name: Grok 3
models.epochNote: Estimated to be approximately 3 months. See compute estimate notes for more details.

models.name: GPT-4.5
models.epochNote: Likely trained for around 4 months/120 days https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1QBmVPm64Ti0xucN0EsZTgSz_I7Mj9hAZ#scrollTo=NYH1ABJuLJlw

models.name: GLM-4.6
models.epochNote: 4 months (from Jaime's correspondence with the GLM team) 4 months * 30 days * 24 hours = 2880 hours
